## Description

**What**: /dso:preplanning conditional load gated by epic's strata:scoped tag (tag-scoped read bound to specific epic-id, NOT global). When gated open, Reads concepts.md + decomposition.md + guidance/preplanning.md at appropriate phases (~120 lines). Read-after-write fence: preplanning's first action verifies tag present with retry; on retry-exhaustion emits named error `[B] strata:scoped tag not present on <epic-id>; retry brainstorm`.
**Why**: Preplanning consumes the tag set by brainstorm; tag-scoped read ensures multi-epic sessions don't bleed Strata loads across non-Strata epics.
**Scope**:
- IN: Phase-conditional Reads; tag-scoped epic-id check; retry-with-escalation; named error on absence.
- OUT: Brainstorm tag-set logic (S4); implementation-plan loads (S6).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, on Strata epic with strata:scoped tag, preplanning Reads concepts + decomposition + preplanning-guidance ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, on Strata project + epic WITHOUT tag, preplanning Reads zero SDK files (tag-scoped) ← Satisfies: SC2, behavioral guarantee tag-scoped-read
- When complete, on strata.skip=true, preplanning Reads zero SDK files regardless of tag ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, preplanning's first action verifies tag with retry; retry-exhaustion emits the named error ← Satisfies: SC3, behavioral guarantee cross-skill-consistency
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for each path

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Tag scope is epic-id specific; never global
- [Reliability] Retry budget bounded (e.g., 3 attempts) before escalation

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As /dso:preplanning, tag-scoped conditional load + first-action tag verification with retry + escalation
